title: GPPD-LD: the Global Power Plant Database as 5-star Linked Open Data (project)
description:
Project snapshot of GPPD-LD: the reproducible Python pipeline, application profile (LDAP), SHACL shapes, ontology and example SPARQL queries that convert the WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0 (CSV, 3-star) into 5-star Linked Open Data. The output (34,936 plants, 1,948,266 triples, 0 SHACL violations) reuses DBpedia, the Open Energy Ontology, GeoSPARQL, PROV-O, RDF Data Cube, SKOS, ADMS and DCAT, and links to the EU country authority table and Wikidata.

University project, Seminars - Data Interoperability, MEIC, FEUP, 2026/2027, Group 2.
